The '''Internal Security Bureau''' was a feared agency within the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Agent]]s of the bureau were present everywhere in order to ensure proper loyalty.<ref name="Dawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Internal Security Bureau was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2018]].<ref name="Dawn" /> The bureau's first mention within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a reference book released in [[2008]].<ref name="Complete SWE">{{CSWECite|II|96|Imperial Security Bureau (ISB)}}</ref>
